about: Barrie is on the western shore of Lake Simcoe, about an hour north of Toronto. It is a regional centre for Simcoe County and a fast-growing commuter and recreation city. Downtown sits on Kempenfelt Bay, with suburbs climbing the hills around the lake. About 150,000 people live in Barrie.
seoSummary: Fast-growing city on Kempenfelt Bay, Lake Simcoe, north of Toronto.
